links.outcome: HPI hypotension prediction performance in non-ventilated PACU/ICU patients, a new population beyond ventilated patients
links.effect: AUC 0.94 overall; at threshold 85, sensitivity 1.00, specificity 0.79, PPV 0.85, NPV 1.00, median time-to-event 160 s. Performance not negatively affected in the non-ventilated population.
links.quote: The absence of positive pressure ventilation and the influence thereof on patient hemodynamics does not negatively affect the performance of the HPI algorithm in predicting hypotension in the PACU and ICU.

screen.reason: This study is an external validation of an existing predictive algorithm (Hypotension Prediction Index, HPI) in a new clinical subpopulation (non-ventilated PACU and ICU patients) using prospectively collected physiological data, evaluating diagnostic accuracy without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
